title.narrative: Education- Enhancing Capacity for Data Collection, Analysis and Monitoring of Student Learning

description.narrative: This grant will finance the building of national capacity for using empirical evidence in the formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of education policies and programs that aim at improving educational outcomes in Syria. Specifically, the grant will (i) support Syria's participation in international education assessments (such as the TIMSS, PISA, PIRLS) which provide a measure for education outcomes globally and allow for benchmarking countries' performance; (ii) enhance the capacity of the Ministry of Education in collecting, analyzing,presenting and disseminating data on student learning and performance; and (iii) support the establishment and capacity building of the Government Education Development Center. Consequently, the grant will This grant will finance the building of national capacity to strengthen the ability of the Government to generate valid, reliable and timely information on student learning and performance that can be used to inform policy formulation and program evaluation in the education sector in Syria. Specifically, the grant will: (i) support the establishment and capacity building of the Government's Center for Education Development, whose functions is evaluation, assessment, and research in education; (ii) establish and build the capacity of a #Student Learning Assessments Unit# within the Ministry of Education that will be responsible for collecting, analyzing and presenting data on student learning and performance; and (iii) support the Unit in the implementation of the 2011 Trends in Mathematical Science Studies (TIMSS) assessment which provide a measure for education outcomes globally and allows for benchmarking countries' performance.
